name: Hyundai Bioscience Co., Ltd.
summary: Hyundai Bioscience Co., Ltd. operates as a biotechnology company. The company provides antivirals and pseudo-resistance therapeutics based on advanced drug delivery technologies. Its products include XAFTY, a broad-spectrum antiviral that activates intracellular autophagy for the treatment of viral diseases, including COVID-19; and POLYTAXEL, a pain-free anticancer therapy. The company also develops XAFTY for the treatment of dengue which is in phase 2/3 clinical trial; Penetrium that is in phase 1 clinical trial for the treatment of castration-resistant prostate cancer and pancreatic cancer. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Gimcheon-si, South Korea.
